photos.c: It's been a good year for John Mackenzie who started off in January by breaking the Scottish Indoor Triple Jump Record with 16.13m, followed up by winning the Scottish Indoor Long Jump Championship, and finished by representing Scotland in the Commonwealth Games in Victoria where he leapt to his longest outdoor mark of 16.12m. John is pictured above at Copthall in BAL Match 2 where he took the 'B' long jump with 7.36w
